title: dcp-async-save-performance
summary: Diagnose training-visible checkpoint pauses using PyTorch Distributed Checkpoint asynchronous saving and staging. Separate snapshot capture, staging completion, upload completion and backend durability; bound in-flight requests and cached CPU buffers before proposing overlap. Use for DCP save performance, not distributed recovery validation.
